watches.name: RAE-3 black wristwatch
watches.description: The RAE-3 black is a mechanical automatic watch with a Miyota 9122 "triple calendar" self-winding mechanical premium movement with day, date and month complications. This premium movement offers dazzling style and stunning design. It features a sleek and elegant black dial with golden hands, polished lugs and case, and a domed front sapphire crystal. The watch is water resistant up to 5 ATM and has a durable stainless steel construction. Watches are shipped from Finland. For shipping we use established well known service providers for you to get the watch safely and on time. For example Finnish Posti and GLS in Europe. Globally for example Finnish Posti and UPS. Finnish Posti uses third parties for deliveries outside Finland. Mechanical automatic watch.
